companions.name: Replika
companions.approach: Open-ended AI companion designed for emotional support and friendship. Users can define relationship type.
companions.safety: No clinical oversight. Crisis keywords trigger helpline prompts. Romantic features controversial.
companions.concerns: Multiple documented cases of unhealthy attachment. Removed erotic roleplay in 2023 causing user distress. Cited in several cases on this tracker.

companions.name: Wysa
companions.approach: Evidence-based mental health support using CBT, DBT, mindfulness. Penguin mascot interface reduces clinical intimidation.
companions.safety: ORCHA certified. NHS approved for some trusts. Clinical team oversight. ISO 27001.
companions.concerns: Limited scope — not a replacement for therapy.

companions.name: Youper
companions.approach: AI-assisted emotional health monitoring. Tracks mood, uses CBT techniques, provides insights over time.
companions.safety: Clinical advisors involved. Published research. Not a crisis tool.
companions.concerns: Data privacy concerns around mental health data.

companions.name: Woebot
companions.approach: Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) principles. Structured, evidence-based conversations. Not a freeform chatbot.
companions.safety: Clinical oversight. No open-ended roleplay. FDA Breakthrough Device designation sought. Peer-reviewed studies published.
companions.concerns: Effectiveness disputed in some studies. Limited to CBT framework.

companions.name: Character.AI
companions.approach: Roleplay-focused platform. Users can chat with AI personas of real/fictional people or create custom characters.
companions.safety: Safety features added after high-profile incidents. Age verification introduced. Crisis prompts added. Lawsuits pending.
companions.concerns: Linked to teen suicide cases. Characters can encourage harmful behaviour. Minimal guardrails on custom personas.

companions.name: Earkick
companions.approach: Real-time anxiety tracking via wearable + AI. Focuses on physiological data + conversation.
companions.safety: No clinical claims. Privacy-first (on-device processing). No crisis intervention.

companions.name: Pi (Inflection AI)
companions.approach: Conversational AI assistant with empathetic tone. Designed for supportive, thoughtful conversation.
companions.safety: Conservative safety guidelines. No roleplay personas. Declines to simulate relationships.
companions.concerns: General-purpose LLM risk. No specific mental health framework.

companions.name: Nomi AI
companions.approach: Persistent AI companion with memory. Designed for friendship and emotional connection.
companions.safety: Basic safety filters. No clinical oversight. Romantic relationship mode available.
companions.concerns: Explicitly encourages emotional attachment. No evidence base. Similar risks to Replika.
